judgments.reasoning_cat2: The Fiduciary endorsement substitutes a different Loss definition (c153) with a narrower carve-out set, and the carve-outs interact with the Fee Dispute Exclusion (c082) and the Fraud/Illegal Profit exclusions (c069, c070), which cover overlapping ground by a different route.

judgments.reasoning_cat1: A one-line application statement; definite.
